text:
sam.sales: Quick thread for FinTrust POC asks: they want BYO-HSM, automated monthly rotation, a documented dual-custodian ceremony option, and permission to run a scoped pen-test. Can ops/security confirm constraints?

eli.engineering: We support BYO-HSM via our per-tenant HSM-proxy. Rotation is API-driven with staged overlap; recommend 10m overlap to avoid unwrap failures. First unwrap after rotation may add single-digit ms latency on cache miss.

nora.security: Requirements we need in the playbook: attestation cert chain, statement that master keys are non-exportable, signed rotation records, and a one-paragraph description of how split-custody would be handled operationally. We don't natively host multi-custodian HSMs.

frank.sre: Ops runbook outline: preflight (whitelist IPs, validate attestation), staging dry-run with simulated custodians, production cutover with phased traffic (10/50/100) and 5m stabilization at each step, rollback plan (map back to old KEK). I'll own the runbook.

zoe.solutions: Pricing note: BYO-HSM POC surcharge ~+20% primarily due to extra ops and attestation packaging. If FinTrust wants Redwood to run the ceremony (PS), that's an extra line item.

sam.sales: Pen-test question: allowed on staging + control-plane with NDA and pentest form?

nora.security: Yes — staging only by default. Need pentest agreement, scope doc, and 5 business days notice. No destructive tests against production.

eli.engineering: Minimal connectivity test for their ops:
```bash
curl -v --cert client.crt --key client.key \
  https://hsm-proxy.fintrust-staging.redwood.ai/health \
  --cacert /path/to/attestation_root.pem
```
Expect: {"status":"ok","attestation_nonce":"<nonce>"}

zoe.solutions: I'll attach a short SOW addendum and a pricing appendix to the deal doc after we confirm QPS.

sam.sales: Action items: zoe - SOW + pricing; nora - one-paragraph split-custody phrasing for the security questionnaire; eli - sample snippets and perf note; frank - runbook draft and pentest scheduling form. I'll update FinTrust by EOD. :thumbsup:
